titulo: Why You Laugh: The Two Conditions Every Joke Has to Meet
descripcion: A joke works when it breaks an expectation and stays harmless at the same time. Remove either one and it dies — and it's almost always the same one that's missing. This episode covers McGraw and Warren's benign violation theory, what your brain actually does in the two phases of a joke (and why explaining one destroys it mechanically, not socially), and three concrete levers for manufacturing the harmless half when you're the one telling it. Plus, at the end, where the theory stops working.
